title: ParlaBot: An Italian Language Pronunciation Coach ☕
chooseDifferentSpeaker: Click ▶️ to sample other speakers and ✅ to change to that speaker

joyride.startTour: 👋 Welcome to ParlaBot! This is a pronunciation coach for Italian language learners. It helps you practice speaking by providing real-time feedback on your pronunciation. Follow the steps below to get started. 🎯
joyride.languageToggle: 🌐 You can switch between English and Italian at any time using the language toggle button.
joyride.languageLevel: 📘 Select your CEFR language level to receive phrases tailored to your proficiency. Click the Select Level button to choose. ParlaBot uses a customizable Text-to-Speech (TTS) engine with two supported methods: Python Coqui TTS and Google TTS.
joyride.hideTranslations: 🙈 Click Hide Translations to challenge yourself without relying on English hints.
joyride.speakerSelection: 🗣️ Choose a speaker voice to practice with. TTS is powered by either Google or Coqui (Torch-based). For Coqui, ParlaBot offers 3 speaker profiles: 2 from Mozilla’s Common Voice and 1 custom-trained on my own voice. Click ▶️ to preview or ✅ to select a voice.
joyride.selectPhrase: 🎲 Click Get Random Phrase to practice a new sentence at your selected level. You can also click 🔁 to manually pick one. Then press Repeat Target Phrase to record, and Stop and Analyze to receive feedback.
joyride.results: 🧪 Apply one or more preprocessing pipelines to your audio recording. Pipelines run in the selected order and modify how your pronunciation is analyzed. Results appear in the Feedback section and show the expected phrase, what you said, and differences. Waveforms for both are also displayed.
joyride.endTour:
🎉 That’s it! ParlaBot is a passion project to dive deeper into machine learning, speech processing, and tools like Go, Python, MongoDB, Terraform, GitHub Actions, and GCP. I built this to revisit my university work in natural language processing. If you enjoy it or have suggestions, reach out via GitHub or LinkedIn. Thanks for using ParlaBot!
Ciao! Ciao!
